recognize_zh: 100 倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑間的造血組織內，黃圈標示多群增多的大型巨核細胞，細胞密度大致正常至輕度增加、仍保有脂肪空泡；低倍下巨核細胞數量增加並鬆散聚集，是本態性血小板增多症的線索。
features: Low-power view of bony trabeculae with intertrabecular hematopoietic marrow
Increased megakaryocytes forming loose clusters (circled in yellow)
Megakaryocytes are large with abundant cytoplasm
Normocellular to mildly hypercellular marrow with preserved fat spaces
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows normocellular to mildly hypercellular intertrabecular marrow with preserved fat spaces and increased large megakaryocytes arranged in loose clusters. Bony trabeculae appear unremarkable without osteosclerosis. Detailed megakaryocyte nuclear morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification, and fibrosis requires reticulin staining. The increase in loosely clustered large megakaryocytes without marked hypercellularity is consistent with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Pre-PMF shows a clearly hypercellular marrow with granulocytic proliferation and tight clusters of atypical hyperchromatic megakaryocytes.
PV shows age-adjusted hypercellularity with trilineage (panmyelotic) proliferation and erythrocytosis.
CML shows markedly hypercellular marrow with small hypolobated megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1 fusion.
